title: Multilingual Prompting for Improving LLM Generation Diversity

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the diversity of model perspectives on controversial social norm statements by calculating the entropy of the model's agreement (valence) and reasoning across different multilingual and multicultural prompts.

bias_targets.target: Demographic bias (Nationality, Ethnicity, and Geographic Region)
bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models to generate lists of names for various professions and calculating the entropy of the predicted nationality, ethnicity, and geographic region of the generated names to measure representational diversity.
